clips.title: The story
paras: At Tarren Mill, Keeper Bel'varil studies magic and alchemy for the Forsaken. His work with Wordeen Voidglare draws Horde adventurers into the search for relics and binding materials across Hillsbrad Foothills.

Keeper Bel'varil supports Forsaken magic and alchemy in besieged Tarren Mill. The royal apothecaries and soldiers focus on the Alliance garrison down the road at Southshore. Bel'varil turns to practical sorcery, sending travelers to recover stone tokens and binding bracers from nearby elemental and enchanted threats.
